L25.text: An athletic event where participants run a specified distance, involves hurdling over obstacles, and requires athletes to stay in their assigned lanes is a hurdle race.

L25.reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (CelestialEvent(x) ∧ Planet(y) ∧ Moon(z) ∧ Star(w) ∧ Alignment(x, y, z, w) ∧ CausesObservableEclipse(x) ∧ OccursPeriodically(x) → PlanetaryEclipse(x))

L25.reference_fol: ∀x∀y (Company(x) ∧ Applicant(y) ∧ MeetsRequirements(y, x) ∧ OpenPosition(x) → CanOfferJob(x, y))

L25.text: A fish that can survive in a wide range of water temperatures, adapt to different environments, and has a varied diet is more likely to be an invasive species.
A natural disaster that involves the shaking and vibration of the Earth's surface due to the release of energy in the Earth's crust is called an earthquake.
A song belongs to the genre of rock music if it features amplified instruments, often includes strong rhythms, and may exhibit rebellious or emotional themes.

L25.reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (SoccerBall(x) ∧ Basketball(y) ∧ Football(z) → (IsRound(x) ∧ UsedInSoccer(x) ∧ IsRound(y) ∧ UsedInBasketball(y) ∧ ¬IsRound(z) ∧ UsedInFootball(z)))

L25.reference_fol: ∀x ∀y (ArtPiece(x) ∧ Artist(y) ∧ UsesTechniquesAndMaterials(y) ∧ Produces(x, y) ∧ ExpressesIdeasOrEmotionsOrConcepts(y) → CreatedBy(x, y))

L25.text: A stringed musical instrument with a wooden body and a long neck, played by plucking or strumming the strings with fingers or a pick, is a guitar.

A visual representation of an area, typically produced on a flat surface, showing geographic features and the relative position of different locations, is a map.
A room is suitable for an event if it can accommodate the number of attendees, provides the necessary equipment, and is available on the desired date.
A plant is characterized as a succulent if it stores water in its leaves or stems, thrives in arid environments, and has specialized adaptations for water conservation.

L25.text: An animal that feeds on dead plant and animal matter, playing a crucial role in breaking down and recycling organic material, is referred to as a detritivore.
A food item is recognized as a dessert if it is sweet, typically consumed after a meal, and may include ingredients such as sugar, fruits, or chocolate.
A person is considered a coach if they train and instruct athletes or teams in a specific sport, often developing strategies and techniques for competition.
A type of food that is made from grain, cooked in water, and served as a side dish or used as an ingredient in other dishes is classified as rice.
A vehicle is an electric vehicle if it is powered by an electric motor, uses batteries to store energy, and does not rely on fossil fuels.
A type of competition that involves two or more teams, follows a set of rules, and aims to determine a winner based on skill or strategy is a board game or a card game.

L25.reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (Zoo(x) ∧ (Africa(y) ∨ Asia(y) ∨ SouthAmerica(y)) ∧ (ConservationProgram(z) ∨ EducationalActivity(z) ∨ ResearchInitiative(z)) → HousesAnimalsAndOrganizesPrograms(x, y, z))

L25.text: A restaurant is popular if it serves delicious food and has excellent service, or if it has a unique theme and is in a prime location.
A celestial event that occurs periodically, involves the alignment of multiple celestial bodies, and is visible from a specific location on Earth is usually a solar or lunar eclipse.
L25.reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (CelestialEvent(x) ∧ OccursPeriodically(x) ∧ AlignmentOfBodies(y) ∧ Involves(x, y) ∧ EarthLocation(z) ∧ VisibleFrom(x, z) → (SolarEclipse(x) ∨ LunarEclipse(x)))

L25.text: If an object is a camera, it must be a device that captures images, either as photographs or videos, by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation.
A plant is considered a tree if it is a perennial woody plant with a single main trunk, branching out with secondary limbs and foliage.
A food x is an ingredient in dish y if x is included in the recipe of y and contributes to the flavor or texture of y.
L25.reference_fol: ∀x ∀y (Food(x) ∧ Dish(y) ∧ InRecipe(x, y) ∧ ContributesToFlavorOrTexture(x, y) → IngredientIn(x, y))

L25.text: Students who study diligently, complete their assignments on time, and actively participate in class discussions are more likely to excel academically than those who do not.
A scientific study is considered valid if it has been peer-reviewed and has a large sample size, but not if it has a high risk of bias.
A type of musical instrument that produces sound by vibrating strings, can be played by plucking or bowing, and has a resonating body to amplify the sound is a stringed instrument.
A disease that can be transmitted from one individual to another is a contagious disease, while a disease that cannot be transmitted between individuals is a non-contagious disease.

L25.text: A visual representation of data in the form of bars or lines, where the lengths or heights correspond to quantities, is known as a chart.
An item is characterized as a book if it is a bound collection of pages, contains written or printed text, and is used for reading or reference purposes.
Glaciers are large masses of ice that form in cold regions and move slowly over time, shaping the landscape and sometimes creating valleys and fjords.
L25.reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (Glacier(x) ∧ ColdRegion(y) ∧ Landscape(z) → (LargeMassOfIce(x) ∧ FormsIn(x, y) ∧ MovesSlowlyOverTime(x) ∧ Shapes(x, z) ∧ SometimesCreatesValleysAndFjords(x)))

L25.text: A food item is a dessert if it is sweet, typically consumed at the end of a meal, and often contains ingredients like sugar, flour, or chocolate.
An organism is a bacteria when it is a single-celled prokaryote, reproduces asexually by binary fission, and may be beneficial or harmful depending on its role in an ecosystem.
A painting technique that involves the application of pigment to a wet plaster surface, allows the pigment to chemically bond with the plaster, and results in a durable artwork is a fresco.
L25.reference_fol: ∀x ∀y ∀z (PaintingTechnique(x) ∧ Pigment(y) ∧ WetPlasterSurface(z) ∧ InvolvesApplicationTo(x, y, z) ∧ ChemicalBondWithPlaster(x) ∧ DurableArtwork(x) → Fresco(x))

L25.text: A sport is an equestrian sport if it involves the riding or racing of horses and generally requires skill, balance, and coordination between the rider and the horse.
An event is a conference if it gathers professionals to discuss and share knowledge in a specific field, but not if it is primarily focused on entertainment.
Lakes, rivers, and groundwater sources supply fresh water, which undergoes treatment to remove contaminants and impurities, ensuring safe and clean water for drinking and other uses.
A planet x hosts life form y when it lies within the habitable zone of its star and possesses the necessary elements and conditions for life.
L25.reference_fol: ∀x ∀y (Planet(x) ∧ LifeForm(y) ∧ InHabitableZone(x) ∧ NecessaryElementsAndConditions(x, y) → Hosts(x, y))

L25.text: A type of natural environment that is characterized by a relatively flat terrain, a lack of significant tree cover, and a mixture of grasses and other plants, is a grassland.
A person is considered a nurse if they provide care and support for patients in a medical setting, often under the supervision of a physician.
An object that absorbs and retains heat, changes its state from solid to liquid, and then releases heat upon solidification is a phase change material.

L25.reference_fol: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Article(x) ∧ ResearchTopic(y) ∧ Researcher(z) ∧ Covers(x, y) ∧ ReputableSource(x) ∧ CitedBy(x, z) → Relevant(x, y, z))

L25.text: A violin is a bowed string instrument with a hollow body, a cello is a larger bowed string instrument, and a double bass is the largest bowed string instrument in an orchestra.
L25.reference_fol: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Violin(x) ∧ Cello(y) ∧ DoubleBass(z) → (BowedStringInstrument(x) ∧ HollowBody(x) ∧ BowedStringInstrument(y) ∧ LargerThanViolin(y) ∧ BowedStringInstrument(z) ∧ LargestInOrchestra(z)))

L25.reference_fol: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Robot(x) ∧ Task(y) ∧ Factory(z) ∧ CapableOfPerforming(x, y) ∧ Available(x) ∧ OpenPosition(y, z) → AssignedTo(x, y, z))

A system is a solar power plant when it is an energy production facility, converts sunlight into electricity, and employs various technologies such as photovoltaic panels or concentrated solar power.
L25.reference_fol: ∀x (System(x) ∧ EnergyProductionFacility(x) ∧ ConvertsSunlightIntoElectricity(x) ∧ EmploysVariousTechnologies(x, photovoltaicPanels, concentratedSolarPower) → SolarPowerPlant(x))

L25.reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (Medication(x) ∧ Disease(y) ∧ Patient(z) ∧ CorrectActiveIngredient(x, y) ∧ Tolerate(z, x) ∧ Susceptible(y, x) → CanEffectivelyTreat(x, y, z))

L25.text: An object can be identified as a fossil when it contains preserved remains or impressions of an ancient organism, is found within sedimentary rock layers, and provides information about Earth's history.

L25.reference_fol: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Book(x) ∧ Publisher(y) ∧ Language(z) ∧ ManuscriptCompleted(x) ∧ DemandInTargetLanguage(x, z) → PublishedByInLanguage(x, y, z))

L25.reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (Pollination(x) ∧ Stamen(y) ∧ Pistil(z) → (TransfersPollenFromStamenToPistil(y, z) ∧ EnablesFertilization(x) ∧ ProducesSeeds(x) ∧ GrowsIntoNewPlants(x)))

L25.text: If an object is a microwave oven, it must be an appliance that uses electromagnetic radiation to heat and cook food quickly and efficiently, often featuring a timer and various power settings.
A star is a supernova if it undergoes a massive explosion that results in the release of an enormous amount of energy and the formation of a neutron star or black hole.

L25.reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (CelestialEvent(x) ∧ Earth(y) ∧ Moon(z) ∧ PassesBetween(y, x, z) ∧ CastsShadowOnSurface(y, z) ∧ AltersAppearance(z) → LunarEclipse(x))

L25.text: A whale is a large marine mammal that breathes through a blowhole, a shark is a carnivorous marine animal with a streamlined body, and a squid is a soft-bodied marine creature with tentacles.
